title: Orientifolds of Gepner models without Kähler moduli
summary: One of the main challenges in string theory Calabi-Yau compactifications to four dimensions is the stabilization of the massless complex structure and Kähler moduli. In type IIB string theory, complex structure moduli can be stabilized perturbatively by turning on fluxes on the internal space, while there is no perturbative mechanism for Kähler moduli stabilization. Since every Calabi-Yau manifold has at least one Kähler modulus (the overall volume), there is no hope to stabilize all moduli perturbatively.
